protocol.test_family: Four paired training-seed score contrasts, Holm separately for t and exhaustive sign flips. Other contrasts exploratory.
protocol.design: Frozen PGC networks; substitute ordinary same-phase grid activity only in specified slots/times. All interventions begin after first discovery. Near means true-center distance <=0.6m, twice reward radius. Early means first15decisions after each pickup/respawn. Goal and current deshifting separate. No state patching or retraining.
protocol.interpretation: Causal stage-conditional input intervention, not mediation percentage. Masks depend on each branch trajectory; recurrence carries history across boundaries. Distance mask uses privileged true center. Input switching can itself perturb computations.

statistics: Eight training seeds are replicates. Marginal95%paired t intervals; Holm t and exactsignflip within listed primary and exploratory families separately. Other endpoints secondary. Research followup on existing evaluation layouts.
